words.gram: 3 sg. pres. mid. desid. (√yaj or √i, uncertain)

hindi: हे मनुष्यो, इस शुद्ध होती हुई बूँद के लिए पास आकर गाओ; वह देवगणों तक पहुँचना चाहता है।
english: Sing near to this one, O men, to the clarifying drop; he seeks to reach the gods.
notes: devā~ is devān (candrabindu for anusvāra/nasal). iyakṣate is a desiderative form; its root is uncertain (yaj 'wishes to worship' or i 'wishes to go'); the rendering 'seeks to reach' follows abhi. indu is rendered 'drop' per the glossary (the open point on 'Indu' as a name is not applied).

hindi: अथर्वणों ने तुम्हारे दूध को मधु से मिला दिया है; देव को, देव के लिए, देव की कामना करने वाला।
english: The Atharvans have mixed your milk with honey; the god, for the god, god-seeking.
notes: payo'tharvāṇo = payaḥ + atharvāṇaḥ ('tharvāṇaḥ with avagraha). Line b is elliptical: devam is taken as the object (the god), devayu as 'god-seeking' agreeing with payaḥ (n.); it could also be read as a nominative plural devayavaḥ (the Atharvans, god-seeking). The reading is uncertain; the translation stays literal. abhi with aśiśrayuḥ is a split verb.

hindi: तुम, हमारे लिए शुद्ध होकर बहो; गाय के लिए कल्याण, जन के लिए कल्याण, घोड़े के लिए कल्याण, हे राजन्, ओषधियों के लिए कल्याण।
english: You, flow clear for us: well-being for the cow, well-being for the people, well-being for the horse, well-being, O king, for the plants.
notes: śa~ in line b is śam (candrabindu for anusvāra). sa is a resumptive pronoun with a second-person verb ('you'). rājann = rājan before a vowel.

words.gram: f. inst. sg. pres. part. pari-√stubh

hindi: चमकते हुए प्रकाश से, गूँजते हुए रूप से उजले सोम दूध से मिले हैं।
english: The bright Somas, mixed with milk, [are] with flashing light, with resounding form.
notes: The verse has no finite verb; 'are' is supplied. śukrā = śukrāḥ and gavāśiraḥ = go-āśiraḥ (go + āśir 'admixture'). pariṣṭobhantyā and kṛpā are obscure: pari-√stubh 'resound' and kṛp 'form' are the usual glosses but the sense is uncertain.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √hi
form uncertain (gen. sg. or nom. pl. of vanuṣ)

hindi: प्रेरित करने वालों से प्रेरित किया हुआ, स्थापित धावक वाज की ओर बढ़ा है; बैठते हुए।
english: Urged on by the impellers, set in place, the racer has stepped to the prize; settling down, as [unclear].
notes: Line b is unclear: sīdantaḥ (nom. pl.) and vanuṣaḥ yathā cannot be tied to the subject with confidence (vanuṣ is rare, 'eager' or 'hostile'). Hindi omits the unclear phrase. vājy akramīt = vājī akramīt.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. sam-√gam

hindi: हे सोम, भलीभाँति कल्याण के लिए मिलते हुए, दिन में, हे कवि, सूर्य के दर्शन के लिए शुद्ध होकर बहो।
english: Aright, O Soma, for well-being, meeting together by day, O seer, flow clear for the seeing of the sun.
notes: ṛdhak is uncertain in meaning ('aright' or 'apart'). divā is taken as 'by day' as printed; the Ṛgvedic parallel has divaḥ ('from heaven'), noted only and not applied. sūryo dṛśe: sūryaḥ is nominative with the dative infinitive dṛśe; the rendering 'for the seeing of the sun' is the usual sense.

hindi: हे कवि, हे धावक, शुद्ध होते हुए तुम्हारी धाराएँ छोड़ी गई हैं, कीर्ति चाहने वाले घोड़ों के समान।
english: Of you who are being clarified, O seer, O racer, the streams have been released, like steeds eager for fame.

text_flags.why: 3 pl. aor. mid. of the plural subject sargāḥ needs -ata; -te looks like a copying slip

notes: Printed asṛkṣate is read as asṛkṣata (flagged). vājintsargā: the t is an inserted consonant in this text (vājin + sargāḥ); not treated as an error. śravasya- is from śravas 'fame'.

hindi: मधु टपकाने वाले कोश की ओर, भेड़ के बालों की छन्नी में वे छोड़े गए हैं; विचार गूँज उठे हैं।
english: Toward the vat dripping honey they were sent forth, into the strainer of sheep's fleece; the thoughts have bellowed.
notes: The subject of asṛgram is not stated in line a; 'they' is the pronoun in the verb ending. dhītayaḥ may also mean 'fingers' in Soma hymns; 'thoughts' is used here.

hindi: समुद्र की ओर बूँदें आ पहुँची हैं, गायों के समान, दुधारू गायों के समान घर की ओर, ऋत के स्थान तक।
english: Toward the ocean the drops have come, like cows, like milch cows, to the home, to the seat of truth.
notes: indavo'staṃ = indavaḥ + astam. The gloss of yoni is 'seat' (literally 'womb, source').

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √gṛ

hindi: हे अग्नि, स्तुति पाते हुए, भोज के लिए और हव्य के दान के लिए आओ; होता बनकर कुशासन पर बैठो।
english: O Agni, come, being praised, for the feast and for the giving of oblations; sit down as Hotṛ priest on the sacred grass.
notes: gṛṇāno = gṛṇānaḥ (before h-). ni satsi is a split verb (ni-√sad). satsi is an aorist subjunctive with imperative sense.

hindi: हे अंगिरस, उस तुम्हें हम समिधाओं से और घी से बढ़ाते हैं; हे सबसे युवा, खूब दीप्त हो।
english: That one, you, O Aṅgiras, we make grow with fuel-sticks and with ghee; blaze greatly, O youngest.
notes: No name of the deity appears in the text; none is added. aṅgiraḥ is the epithet-form 'Aṅgiras'. bṛhacchocā = bṛhat + śocā.

hindi: तुम, हे देव, हमें विस्तृत, कीर्ति के योग्य, महान उत्तम वीरता प्रदान करते हो, हे अग्नि।
english: You, O god, bestow on us wide, famed, great good heroism, O Agni.
notes: vivāsasi (vi-vas, 'serve, win, bestow') is uncertain in sense; 'bestow' follows acchā ('toward'). sa is a resumptive pronoun with a second-person verb. suvīryam is a su-compound (su + vīrya), not split at a suffix.

hindi: हे मित्र और वरुण, हमारे लिए घी से चरागाह को सींचो, मधु से अंतरिक्ष के लोकों को, हे उत्तम शक्ति वालो।
english: O Mitra and Varuṇa, sprinkle for us the pasture with ghee, the airy realms with honey, O ones of good power.
notes: no = naḥ (here 'for us'; 'our' is also possible). gavyūti is a measure of cattle-range; rendered 'pasture'. In line b the token is madhvā + rajāṃsi + sukratū in the order given. madhvā = madhunā (contracted instrumental).

hindi: हे विस्तृत स्तुति वालो, नमन से बढ़ने वालो, महिमा से तुम दोनों कौशल पर शासन करते हो, सबसे लम्बियों के साथ, हे शुद्ध व्रत वालो।
english: O widely praised, strengthened by homage, by greatness you two rule over skill, with the longest [ones], O pure in observance.
notes: The text names no deities; the dual address is kept as 'you two'. The feminine plural drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ has no noun in the verse; the noun is left unsupplied. rājathaḥ with genitive is taken as 'rule over'; 'shine' is possible. namovṛdhā = namaḥ-vṛdhā.

words.gram: m. nom. du. pres. part. pass. √gṛ

hindi: जमदग्नि द्वारा स्तुति पाते हुए तुम दोनों ऋत के स्थान पर बैठो; सोम पियो, हे ऋत को बढ़ाने वालो।
english: Being praised by Jamadagni, you two sit in the seat of truth; drink Soma, O increasers of truth.
notes: pāta~ is pātam (candrabindu for anusvāra). Jamadagni is a name; no role is added. The two addressed are not named in this verse.

hindi: आओ; हे इन्द्र, हमने तुम्हारे लिए निचोड़ा है; इस सोम को पियो; इस कुशासन पर, मेरे आसन पर आओ।
english: Come; for we have pressed for you, O Indra; drink this Soma; [come] to this sacred grass, my seat.
notes: edaṃ = ā + idam. The ā of line b is taken with yāhi ('come'), supplied in brackets in English; sadaḥ is taken as noun 'seat' in apposition with barhiḥ ('my seat'); an imperative sada would not stand before mama. suṣumā hi = suṣuma hi with Vedic lengthening.

hindi: हे इन्द्र, ब्रह्म से जुते हुए, केशों वाले दो भूरे घोड़े तुम्हें यहाँ लाएँ; हमारे पवित्र वचनों को सुनो।
english: Let the two tawny horses, yoked by the sacred word, long-maned, carry you here, O Indra; hear our sacred words.
notes: upa with śṛṇu is a split verb ('listen to'). keśin 'having hair/mane' is not split at the suffix.

hindi: हम ब्रह्मन् पुरोहित सोम रखने वाले, निचोड़ चुके, साथ मिलकर तुम्हें, सोम पीने वाले को, हे इन्द्र, बुलाते हैं।
english: We Brahman priests, possessing Soma, having pressed it, together call you, the Soma-drinker, O Indra.
notes: yujā 'with a yoke-fellow / together' is adverbial and slightly uncertain. vaya~ = vayam; somapāmindra = soma-pām + indra. sutāvant 'having pressed' is not split at -vant; somin 'owning Soma' not split at -in.

hindi: हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, स्तुतियों के साथ निचोड़े हुए वरणीय के पास आओ; इसे पियो, बुद्धि से प्रेरित होकर।
english: O Indra and Agni, come with songs to the pressed, [unclear], choice one; drink of this, impelled by thought.
notes: nabhaḥ here is obscure ('vapour/sky' or a term for the offering); left [unclear] in English and omitted in Hindi. ā gatam: 'ā' is taken with gatam. iṣitā is the participle of iṣ 'send, impel', not iṣ 'refreshment'. vareṇya is not split at -ya. The doubt makes this unit low confidence.

hindi: हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, स्तोता के साथ सचेत यज्ञ जाता है; इस प्रकार इस निचोड़े हुए को पियो।
english: O Indra and Agni, the attentive sacrifice goes together with the singer; in this way drink this pressed [drink].
notes: jarituḥ sacā: sacā is taken as a preposition-like adverb 'together with' (genitive). ayā is adverbial. cetana is taken as 'attentive, conscious'. The construction of line a is somewhat loose.

hindi: मैं इन्द्र को, अग्नि को, यज्ञ की गति से चुनता हूँ; वे दोनों यहाँ सोम से तृप्त हों।
english: Indra, Agni, [unclear], by the speed of the sacrifice I choose; may those two here be satisfied with Soma.
notes: kavicchadā is obscure (kavi 'seer' + chadā, perhaps a dual 'covered / covering'); it is left [unclear] in English and omitted in Hindi. The double c is the printed doubling after a short vowel. jūtyā = 'by impulse, speed'. The doubt makes the unit low confidence.

words.gram: n. nom. sg. pp. √jan used as noun

hindi: ऊँचा है तुम्हारा जन्म, रस का; आकाश में होता हुआ मैं पृथ्वी पर उग्र शरण, महान कीर्ति ग्रहण करता हूँ।
english: On high is your birth, of the juice; being in heaven, I take on earth mighty shelter, great fame.
notes: The construction is uncertain: divi sat could qualify jātam ('born in heaven'), and bhūmi may be a locative or an accusative with ā dade. The rendering is literal and tentative. uccā te jātam: te and andhasaḥ are both genitives of the same noun (jātam). ugra~ = ugram (candrabindu). ā dade = 'I take'.

hindi: तुम, खुला स्थान पाने वाले, हमारे लिए, पूजा के योग्य इन्द्र के लिए, वरुण के लिए, मरुतों के लिए चारों ओर बहो।
english: You, finder of wide room, flow around for us, for Indra worthy of worship, for Varuṇa, for the Maruts.
notes: varivovit = varivaḥ-vit (varivas 'wide room, freedom' + vid 'finder'). yajyu is taken as 'worthy of worship'. na = naḥ before indrāya.

words.gram: m. voc. sg. (or aryaḥ gen. sg.)

hindi: इससे, हे स्वामी, मनुष्यों के सब द्युम्न जीतने की इच्छा करते हुए हम प्राप्त करें।
english: By this, O lord, wishing to win all the splendours of men, may we win [them].
notes: arya is ambiguous: arya (voc., 'lord, master') or aryaḥ (gen., 'of the stranger / master') before ā; the vocative is used. ā vanāmahe: ā is taken with the verb; 'them' is implied by the verb's object. Hindi the object is left unexpressed in Hindi. enā is the instrumental of the pronoun ena.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √vas

hindi: हे सोम, धारा से शुद्ध होते हुए, जलों को धारण किए हुए तुम बहते हो; रत्न देने वाले, तुम ऋत के स्थान पर बैठते हो, स्रोत, देव, स्वर्णमय।
english: Being purified, O Soma, with the stream, wearing the waters, you flow; bestower of jewels, you sit down in the seat of truth, the spring, the god, golden.
notes: dhārayāpo = dhārayā + apaḥ. ā with sīdasi is a split verb ('sit down in/on'); yoni is 'seat'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √duh

hindi: दिव्य थन को दुहता हुआ, प्रिय मधु को, उसने प्राचीन साझा स्थान ग्रहण किया है; तुम, धावक, पूछने योग्य आधार तक बहते हो, मनुष्यों द्वारा धोए हुए, दूरदर्शी।
english: Milking the heavenly udder, the dear honey, he has settled on the ancient common seat; you, a racer, flow to the support worth asking for, washed by men, far-seeing.
notes: The syntax is loose: divyam can go with ūdhaḥ or with madhu; the person shifts between āsadat (3rd) and arṣasi (2nd). dharuṇam is taken as the goal of arṣasi (acc.). sadhastha is rendered 'common seat'. duhāna ūdhar = duhānaḥ ūdhaḥ.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū
m. nom. pl. pres. part. caus. √mṛj

hindi: आगे दौड़ो, अब कोश के चारों ओर बैठो; मनुष्यों द्वारा शुद्ध होते हुए वाज की ओर बहो। घोड़े के समान, धावक तुम्हें माँजते हुए वे कुशासन की ओर लगाम की रस्सियों से ले जाते हैं।
english: Run forth now, sit down around the vat; being purified by men, flow toward the prize. Like a horse, a racer, cleansing you, they lead you toward the sacred grass with reins.
notes: barhī is an irregular form (barhis); taken as the goal 'toward the sacred grass'. pari kośam ni ṣīda could also be 'sit down in the vat'. tvā is the object of both marjayantaḥ and nayanti; aśvaṃ na with vājinam compares you to a racing horse. The glossary pair vāja/vājin is followed.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √rakṣ

hindi: सुशस्त्र देव बूँद शुद्ध होता है, शाप को मारने वाला, घेरों की रक्षा करता हुआ; देवों का पिता, जन्म देने वाला, उत्तम कौशल वाला, आकाश का स्तम्भ, पृथ्वी का आधार।
english: The well-armed god, the drop, clarifies himself, slayer of the curse, guarding the enclosures; father of the gods, begetter, of good skill, prop of heaven, support of earth.
notes: vṛjana (enclosure, district, or strength) is uncertain; 'enclosures' is tentative. aśasti is rendered 'curse' (also 'ill-repute, slander'). indu is rendered 'drop' per the glossary. divaḥ is rendered 'of heaven' (div = heaven).

hindi: ऋषि, प्रेरित मेधावी, जनों के अग्रणी, कुशल, धीर, कवित्व से उशना; उसी ने छिपे हुए को पाया, जो इनका गुप्त नाम है, गौओं का।
english: The sage, the inspired one, leader of the peoples, the skilled, the wise, Uśanā by seer-wisdom; he indeed found the hidden, which is the secret name of these cows.
notes: Token apīcyā3ṃ = apīcyam with pluta 3. viveda (pf. of vid) may mean 'found' or 'knew'; 'found' fits nihitam. ṛbhu is rendered 'skilled one' and not read as a name. apīcya 'hidden, secret' is from apīc. Uśanā is kept as a name only (no Kāvya role added); kāvyena is taken as 'by seer-wisdom'.

hindi: हे शूर, हम तुम्हारी ओर ऊँचे स्वर से पुकारते हैं, बिना दुही दुधारू गायों के समान; इस चलते जगत के स्वामी, सूर्य के प्रकाश को देखने वाले, हे इन्द्र, स्थिर के स्वामी को।
english: We bellow toward you, O hero, like unmilked milch cows; you the ruler of this moving world, seeing the light of heaven, the ruler, O Indra, of what stands.
notes: The token nonumo'dugdhā = nonumaḥ + adugdhāḥ (avagraha). īśānam is accusative, in apposition to tvā. jagat is 'the moving'; tasthuṣaḥ 'of what stands' (the unmoving). svar = light of heaven per the glossary.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. denom.
m. nom. pl. pres. part. denom.

hindi: तुम्हारे समान कोई दूसरा न आकाशीय, न पार्थिव; न उत्पन्न हुआ, न उत्पन्न होगा। घोड़ों की इच्छा करते हुए, हे मघवन्, हे इन्द्र, धावक, गायों की इच्छा करते हुए हम तुम्हें बुलाते हैं।
english: No other like you, heavenly or earthly, nor born, nor will be born. Desiring horses, O Maghavan, O Indra, racers, desiring cows, we call you.
notes: tvāvā~ = tvāvān (candrabindu); -vān is not split. The first line is read as 'no other like you, whether heavenly or earthly, has been born or will be born'. vājinaḥ is taken as 'racers', agreeing with the 'we' of havāmahe.
